scope: Short P0→O→C→K0 roadmap Round 1 strict-OOF opportunity definition sweep; research only, no canonical/live change.

contract.architecture: P0 target-free winner → O opportunity probability → C conditional T5 policy-regret conversion → K0 analytic mixture
contract.inference_population: all target-free P0 candidates; invalid paths excluded only after scoring
contract.selection: outer-training inner-OOF p80 K0 expected-policy-EV threshold

winner_selection.rationale: O250_H6 has the strongest 2025–26 mean economics (+113.46 bps/trade) while satisfying both-era and participation gates. O300_H12 has the strongest stability among advancing arms (all 2026 months positive, +13.72 bps worst month), with +104.18 bps/trade and the highest total net bps. O200_H6 passed the minimum gate but is dominated on mean economics and has a weaker worst month.

caveat: 2025–2026 are model-selection evidence, not an untouched promotion period.
